about: The diagnostic code table of contract section 4.4, generated from the C# catalog. message is the fixed English text readers report; fix is the author fix, where {tool} stands for the tool's command name; sharedConvention is true when the Ventana code-naming convention (contract section 2.7) shares the code's string and meaning across products.

codes.message: The file is larger than its size limit.
The file is not valid JSON: a bad token, a comment, a trailing comma, trailing content or invalid UTF-8.
codes.fix: Fix the JSON at the reported line and column.

codes.message: The file starts with a UTF-16 or UTF-32 byte order mark.
Objects and arrays nest deeper than 8 levels.
This member is not part of the schema: a typo, or a member of a newer schema.
The same member appears twice in one object.
null is not a valid value here.
codes.fix: Give a value or leave the member out.

codes.message: A required member is missing.
The value has the wrong JSON type, or is a number that is not an integer.
This member was renamed in schema 3 (capabilities is now provides; manifestVersion is now schemaVersion).
The value is not one of the documented values.
The manifest is null.
A list or object member is null.
codes.fix: Give a value or an empty list.

codes.message: A list entry is null.
The reader failed in a way the contract does not describe; the file is refused.
codes.fix: Report it; the file is still refused.

codes.message: This format version is not supported by this reader.
codes.fix: Use the version in the contract, or update the host.

codes.message: $schema is an http or https URL that is not the published schema of any listed host.
codes.fix: Use a published schema URL, or a relative path to a local copy.

codes.message: The list has more entries than allowed.
The list has fewer entries than required.
The text is longer than allowed.
The text is empty, or contains only white space or format characters.
The text starts or ends with white space.
The text contains a disallowed character: a control, bidirectional or invisible format character, a noncharacter or an unpaired surrogate.
codes.fix: Remove control, bidirectional-override and invisible characters.

codes.message: This name is longer than 32 characters and will be truncated.
Reporting stopped after 199 diagnostics.
codes.fix: Fix the reported problems and validate again.

codes.message: The id is missing or blank.
The id contains characters, segments or slashes the id grammar does not allow.
codes.fix: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

codes.message: The id is longer than 128 characters.
A third-party extension id must contain a dot (publisher.name).
A first-party id must not contain a dot.
The id starts with a reserved publisher, or its first segment is a Windows device name.
A contribution id must be the extension id, a slash and segments; only a lone contribution may use the extension id itself.
codes.fix: Prefix it with the extension id.

codes.message: Two contributions share this id.
Another installed extension already uses this id.
codes.fix: Remove the other extension, or use Reload or Replace in developer mode.

codes.message: The name is empty, or contains only white space or format characters.
The glyph is missing or empty.
The glyph is not exactly one character in U+E000 to U+F8FF.
codes.fix: Pick a Segoe Fluent Icons glyph and write it as \uXXXX.

codes.message: The version is not MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with numbers.
The host id does not match the host-id grammar.
codes.fix: Use an id from the host-id registry.

codes.message: This host id is listed twice.
This host's id is not listed in hosts.
This host id is not an active host in the registry.
provides contains a value other than invoke or face.
provides lists this value twice.
The setting id is missing or blank.
The setting id is not a lowercase letter followed by letters or digits.
codes.fix: Use an id like mode or refreshRate.

codes.message: Two settings of this contribution share this id.
The setting's name is empty, or contains only white space or format characters.
kind is not Choice, the only setting kind of schema 3.
A Choice setting has no choices.
A Choice setting has no default.
default is not one of the setting's choice values.
The choice value is missing or empty.
The choice value is not a lowercase segment.
Two choices share this value.
The choice's name is empty, or contains only white space or format characters.
This required capability id is not in the registry this tool knows.
codes.fix: Check the id, or update the tool.

codes.message: This host does not implement a required capability.
codes.fix: Update the host, or remove the requirement.

codes.message: This capability id is listed twice.
The URL is not an absolute https URL of printable ASCII, without user information, of at most 512 characters.
The language tag does not match the tag grammar.
The strings file name is not a language tag.
language differs from the file name's tag.
Two strings files have the same language tag.
This key names a contribution, setting or choice the manifest does not have.
There are more than 64 strings files.
The archive is larger than 32 MiB.
The expanded contents are larger than 64 MiB.
This file is larger than its limit.
The archive has more than 512 entries.
The ZIP structure is malformed or inconsistent: the central directory, a local header that disagrees with it, overlapping or non-contiguous entries, or bytes before the first entry.
The archive uses ZIP64.
This entry is encrypted.
This entry's CRC-32 or size does not match its data.
This entry name breaks the path grammar.
This entry is not one of the names allowed at the archive root or in strings/.
Two entries differ only in case, or a file and a folder share a name.
This entry is marked as a symbolic link, a device, or with attributes that are not allowed.
A required file is missing: extension.json, extension.package.json or README.md.
extension.package.json is invalid; its own diagnostics follow.
The descriptor lists a file the archive does not contain.
The archive contains a file the descriptor does not list.
A file's SHA-256 or size differs from the descriptor.
The descriptor's manifestHash differs from the manifest's hash.
README.md is empty, not UTF-8, contains NUL, or is too large.
The package file name does not end with this host's package file extension.
codes.fix: Use the package file extension of the host-id registry.

codes.message: The update's version is not higher than the installed one.
extension.pack.json is invalid; its own diagnostics follow.
A from path does not exist.
codes.fix: Correct the path, or add a build step.

codes.message: The build step's dotnet publish failed.
codes.fix: Fix the build errors it printed.

codes.message: A staged file or folder is a symbolic link or junction.
A staged file looks like a pairing file; pairing files are never packed.
The output file exists.
